# indusmova

> indusmova turns a question into an answer taken from a published encyclopaedia
> entry, with the source attached. Ask in your own words in Hindi or English and
> get the answer, its key points, the topics the entry covers, and a link to the
> original page. Nothing is written by a model: every line is a sentence from the
> source, selected and ordered, so the answer can be checked against the page it
> came from.

indusmova is a browser-only reader. There is no account, no API key and no
backend; the search calls go from the visitor's browser to the public Wikimedia
APIs, and anything saved stays in that browser's own storage.

## What this site is for

- A reader who wants an answer rather than a list of links.
- A reader who wants to check the answer against the page it came from.
- A reader working in Hindi or English, or in any of the twelve language
  editions the search offers.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://indusmova.pages.dev/): ask a question, or open the chat.
- [Articles](https://indusmova.pages.dev/articles/): the published entries, as
  static pages that read without JavaScript.
- [Topics](https://indusmova.pages.dev/topics/): the entries grouped by subject.
- [Questions](https://indusmova.pages.dev/questions/): questions this site can
  answer, written out in full.
- [How it works](https://indusmova.pages.dev/how-it-works/): where the text comes
  from, and what is and is not generated.
- [Help](https://indusmova.pages.dev/help/): how to use the site.
- [Research Desk](https://indusmova.pages.dev/research/): search, inspect and
  compare sources directly.

## How to cite an answer from this site

Quote the entry, not this site, and link the original page shown under each
answer. Article text is available under CC BY-SA 4.0 from the Wikimedia
projects; indusmova is an independent reader and is not affiliated with or
endorsed by the Wikimedia Foundation.

## Notes for automated readers

- Every entry page is static HTML and readable without JavaScript.
- `sitemap.xml` lists every crawlable page with a priority and a change
  frequency.
- `robots.txt` allows all crawlers and points at the sitemap.
- The interactive answer chat needs JavaScript; the entries do not.
